class: a branch stacked on an unmerged branch, whose base declares no tiers, measured without the tiers the default branch declares
caught_by: when neither the base nor the working tree declares tiers, QA and Step 0d read the gates config on the default branch (origin/HEAD, origin/main or main, the first that resolves) and run its tiers with --instruments-from that ref. QA writes instruments_from and labels its barrier section, the FINAL's Instrument moved line carries it, and a tier that cannot run that way is a stale gate
missed_by: QA read the base's config, found no tiers and took the without-tiers path, and the FINAL never said the tiers were absent
